# Thermal Cycle Statistics

Category: thermal

Inspect a compact thermal cycle with peak and mean temperatures.

import numpy as np

temperature_c = np.array([25, 120, 240, 315, 280, 160, 60], dtype=float)
print('peak_C =', float(np.max(temperature_c)))
print('mean_C =', round(float(np.mean(temperature_c)), 2))
{'peak_C': float(np.max(temperature_c)), 'mean_C': float(np.mean(temperature_c))}
